# Grégoire — L’unité de langue (4 June 1794)

Grégoire, Henri. “L’unité de langue.” Speech of 4 June 1794. Assemblée nationale historical transcription, consulted 8 September 2026. The published text contains explicit omissions. Editorial introductory framing is distinct from the transcribed speech. No complete-report or annexed-decree collation is claimed.

The speech **historicises** [E3’s Logos/Nomos/Natio relation](../../../../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) and the [language–law–nation history](../../../../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/HISTORY.md).

<a id="passages"></a>
## Selected argument

<a id="gregoire-1794-unite-de-langue-q001"></a>
### q001 — Access to office and elimination of regional idioms

**Paraphrase:** Grégoire argues that inadequate French can compromise public records, while excluding those without it can recreate hierarchy. He advocates linguistic uniformity and the disappearance of regional idioms, answering an objection based on southern attachment and literary traditions. The stated egalitarian aim and assimilative remedy belong to the same intervention.

**Locator:** paragraphs beginning “Tous les membres du souverain”, “Cet état de choses” and the subsequent southern-language objection in the [official excerpted transcription](https://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/decouvrir-l-assemblee/histoire/les-grands-discours-parlementaires/revolution-francaise/l-abbe-gregoire-4-juin-1794).

**Verification:** transcribed excerpt read, including the reported language counts and concluding programme, 2026-09-08. **Boundary:** counts are the speaker’s claims; policy, implementation and counter-testimony need independent evidence. The excerpt cannot stand for all voices within the affected languages.
